title: SolvePolicyResults
description: ADR 0078 D4.5 (X06; ADR 0019 Amendment 18): the response shapes of the protocol `SolvePolicies` (`register_solve_policy`, `get_solve_policy`). `application-results.schema.json` reaches each by a bare `$ref` of the same name, so that the `sha256` names they declare (`expected_sha256`, `actual_sha256`) stay in X06's numerical-policy addendum and out of the v2 policy's domain (ADR 0025 D2.3; R-1032's structure; X06 decision X06-CI1-1).

solve_policy_registration.description: ADR 0078 D4.5: `register_solve_policy`'s result. `registered`: the id is now bound to the document's canonical bytes; `exists`: it was bound to these bytes already; `conflict`: to other bytes, both hashes in `conflict` (`expected_sha256` the request's, `actual_sha256` the stored one, which `policy_sha256` repeats); `replayed`: the original result of the same request under the same key. An id is never re-bound.

solve_policy_view.description: ADR 0078 D4.5: `get_solve_policy`'s result: an offered (`builtin`) or project-registered (`project`) solve policy, its `policy_sha256` (the SHA-256 of the document's canonical bytes, as a run manifest records it) and the document.
